text:
Rent due
My rent is overdue
I don't know what to do
Cause she needs me too
But I need you
How can we both be happy
When neither of us have a home
To call our own
And all that money is just going out the window
It's up in smoke
We're down and out
Just like how my momma used to tell me
Tellin' me it'd get better
That things would change
Guess they were wishful thinking
Cause here we are again

Graveyard shift
Got no choice but to work in the graveyard shit
You coulda been anything if you put half as much effort into your grades
Instead of being stoned on a Friday night
Now they say you can't get it right
When all this time
I was just waiting for you
To pull through
But we both knew that
That was never gonna be true
We were 10,23 and I was already starting to feel older than you
How did life do me so wrong
Why am i always feeling like I'm not enough
Look how much weight is adding up
In my head
Trying to convince myself

You want me to be your brother?
I'm here for you
Always here for y'all
Lookin at the world and that I can see all
The darkness in the light
And these lights ain't bright
But we're shining through
Like there's no other way
That's how it is today
We tryna break away
From everything they say
They tried to brain us with those fake days
Yeah, yeah
Fake days
Try not to fall
Don't look up cause heaven won't call

Dedicated to my momma
I just want you know
That I appreciate the hard work
Cause that all i ever get is pain from them on earth
So thank uhm lord
For everything we've been through
Thank uhm Lord
For every time they said i'd never make it
I'm so sorry for your heart break
But this world can be a little harsh
You always made me feel like there was nothin' worth
Nothin' worse
Than being myself
Now look how far i've come
Lookin up toward God
Feelin like some of his angels

Cold case
It be 1995 in the cold wave
Just had a conversation with my daughter about some of these things that she don't understand
I'm sorry I wasn't there to talk you through all this pain
But at least we still have our love
That's why we were able to get past the way it was
And build something better
We can look back and thank God for what he did
To make us stronger
Look how far we've come
How much we've changed
Still we could never really change
The world we live
Even if we try
You know life ain't perfect
There'll always be problems

Paper trail
I've never known what it's really like to see the world through some else eyes
This could be my life story
But I'm just tryna live my life right
Cause if you look into these past years
It'll all come clear
At 21 I'm still in search of a better future
My momma lost her mind
Dad can't afford to pay for rent
So we were evicted
Then he was fired
We had no choice but to move outta state
Lookin up at God and wondering why he didn't hear our prayer
So now I'm here with this paper trail
Just ask me how its been
All i can say is thank uhm lord

Lemme break it down for you
We on that clock the whole town look up to
I just wanna spend my life with uhm
You'd be lucky if I spent a minute witchu
That's what we know
It is how we grow
There ain't no excuse
Spend yo time with who
They really love
When it comes right down to it
This world can change
Love can save
Just like the bible said
Don't let anyone tell ya different
Look at Jesus they still hate him
But he forgave

I'm a step dad
You think that makes me different than them dads?
No , I just love my daughter more than the other girls
That's why she call me daddy
Instead of her momma
She look up to me
When it comes down
They come out
So you can't take no shit from another man
Cause he actin' like some muthafucka
Just tryna get on your level again
Like they never talk about how we livin
And what do these rappers know
About real life
My whole world revolved around being with this woman and making money so our kids could have a better life
What was I supposed to be

Last bus home
I'm sitting alone
Feeling so lost
Wish my momma was here
Tellin me everythings gonna be okay
But that's what they say
That's why I pray
Can't go it this way
It just never seems to change
All the things you said when we were young
Said everything would be alright
Could have prepared for life
If only I had listened
Don't ever tell your child not to listen
Cause he'll take his own advice one day
And wonder how can she walk away

Ankle monitor
Ain't it funny
How the world can change in a minute
When you least expect
Just like your life
You know how they say
Don't put all of my eggs into one basket
But I only see this world through these stained glasses
I've been hurt
Had the devil whisper
In my ear
That he was here
Tell me that there's nothing to fear
Then he'd disappear
And leave me with more than fears
The worst enemy you could ever have is yourself

I really don't know what it is
But I just feel like today
Is the first day of my life
It's been a long time since someone has looked at me
And said that you're ok
That you'll be okay
You can get through this
Cause we all go thru shit
We deal with pain n it hurts
Sometimes it doesn't even hurt
Then one day our minds start to let us down
Panic attacks, fear and doubt
Told myself if i keep thinking about how much hate there was
The world will follow cause
How many people are truly happy
There's so many problems in the world

The hospital hallway
What I have to say
Could not be the same if you wasn't in my head right now
I've been here for over a year
It's about time we told them what is really going on
They keep trying to make me feel like it's all gonna go away
But how can I believe that after being given such false hope
You were so sick
I was scared of losing myself
My momma kept telling me
Everything would work out
How could she know
She didn't want to lose her baby girl
Me neither
That's why I'm writing this letter
To tell you there just got to be better

I ain't no master at the pawn shop
But I'd be glad to show you what it's like
To have a dream that can make uhm hate you
No matter how hard you try
You'll never satisfy
They wanna know why
We love our lives
Why we put up with all these lies
So they could take away from us
The things we knew was right
Tell me why
Did Jesus die
That he would pay for my life
When i've spent so much time
Tryna save myself
Ain't got enough faith in god

Girl you're just like the glass house
You can't handle it cause I'm too good for you
I'll be with them other bitches
But I won't admit it
It's not what they think
Cause we both know
They don't really matter
At least that's how I feel
And if you were to ask me
That's probably true
For all intents and purposes
There's only two of us
In this world
Just tryna find our way
Tryna make it through
Like a bad romance

I'm not perfect
But I'm honest with my words
Cause that's the only way to really show them
What you're worth
And it ain't easy
To be real
When all we do is pretend
Tryna figure out how others see us
So we can get some more of what they did for me in
This world
We never had a choice but to choose
So who are we to even say what we refuse
Most of our problems come from people being too selfish
Too concerned about themselves
Not seeing the world through other peoples eyes
The things we tell ourselves when were just trying to justify

Sunday afternoon
Sitting in my room
Pretending I don't know
What's been going on
Can't even stand to look at you
I've tried so hard
To make it right
But how can someone change when they are weak inside
The more i try the worse things get
How am I supposed to feel if this is all just a dream
Please God help me
Tell me what to do
Why did he have to take her from me
There ain't no way that we could ever really be
And now she gone
So far away

I remember it was a Saturday back in 2014
That's when my momma told me to leave the house
Tell her that I'm sorry
I know she did not mean what you said
You're never gonna be as perfect as we thought
But maybe I can learn how to love myself
If i truly want this world to change
It has to start with me
So forgive all of your past mistakes
And don't give up on yourself
Look where God brought us from
He'll bring us home
God will bring us home
Let go let go
Just let go
Let go

Damn girl I can't believe you've been on my mind for years
I used to love the idea of a life where we'd be with our peers
But at that time how could i have known if she was really worth it
You were so far away all I did was sit
And look up at stars and think about us
Wishin' she'd come back
Wishin' she would see
The man in me
Tryna show her all these things
That's why
When your voice came over the line
My heart couldn't fight
It felt like home again
Even though I had nothin left to give
All I do is wonder why God keepin y'all apart
Why he let ya'll suffer

I really hope you know
That it is only a prayer for the pain in my soul to go
So that I can be there for you and provide for your home
Provide love enough so we don't need any more homes
You're gonna be okay no matter what life brings
Cause I see beyond all of these things
Beyond this broken world
We'll find our way
Just like how God found us
Yeah, yeah
God found us
Found us
Just like he did me
And just like he will heal
We'll heal
We'll heal

I've seen a lot of pain
I'm not surprised when I feel the same
If it's 2 am and you're still awake
Tell me where all my patience came
Where did this flow come from
How was I able to change
Look at what God has made
You can hate
There is no excuse for your actions
Love is in every action
What are we waiting on
Why don't we just love
Let go
Just let go
Don't worry bout that shit
It'll be okay

Early shift again
Staring at the ceiling
Dreaming of what could be
Wishin all on me
Look up to god for help
He always seems so far away
Couldn't even save my momma from the pain they put her through
Like I ain't feel it too
I'm just glad she still in heaven
No more haters spitting venom
Ain't no one talkin bout them fakes
There's a lot that you can say
But I'll take these words back
Cause this is how we live
This is how
We survive

Empty lot
Got the world on my mind
Wish to change it but I'm scared of what they'll do
Tell me is that true
If you look at all we've done
Look how far we're come
It shouldn't even be a question
We're livin better than our parents
So there's no reason for us not to
But yet here we are
Still tryna find ourselves in these empty lots
Tryna climb outta our own misery
I swear if I could
Then I would
Give anything
Just give me this

Parking lot prays
In my mind there's lots of different ways
To say I'm sorry for the past mistakes
I've made
If only you could see how much it hurts
When you're gone
Lookin up at God
Tryna find a way to tell him
How much he means
At least that will bring me peace
Just like when we were younger
Used to pray together
That momma would just stop hurting
But she never did
She was always in pain
Sometimes I wonder

Fake friends real problems
Real friends fake talkin
It's the world we live in
You can sit and write it
Or you can change it
I choose to change this
That is why i'm here today
Fuck what they say
i am who I am
Thank God for my past
And how far i've came
Not because i hate
But cause of all that love
Shout out nana
For tryna save me
Even though she couldn't be

Two jobs
Just tryna make a life
Can't count the nights I've cried
Tryna change my life
I thought that it was so hard to be there for you
So how could i take care of me too
Now look what's happened
Look at where we've been
I'm sorry baby
But things are finally starting to feel like maybe they'll heal
For real
This is gonna heal
We're gon na find our way
Put all this pain away
You and I can do anything
As long as we believe

It was my first time
Momma took me to the hospital
She said it ain't gonna be ok
But there's a brighter day
You can come back from anything
There will be days you're not feeling
And they'll try and tell ya
That's just how life goes
Well I don't believe that
I've been through depression
Told myself these feelings are temporary
They were all lies
Broke up with my momma
Said we couldn't do this
We weren't good enough
Not even our parents believed in us

I can't believe they told me I'd be a man one day
Cause all these men that claim to love just take my soul away
I'm so tired of letting go
This world say you gotta let it show
But how the hell do you even show what's in your heart
When every time you open up
You're judged for not being different enough
Or too much
It seem like this world don't want us no matter who we are
So why even try
Letting someone else know who you really are
The real cost
Is almost more than I can bear
Can someone tell me is there
Someone out there
Tellin' God he ain't fair

It's three in the morning
Lying here lookin up at the ceiling
The sun is just now startin to rise
And I'm still tryna catch it right there with my eyes
Cause I can't face another day like this
I've been stuck inside of myself for years
Pretending that things were okay
But a part of me was never ok
So what do you think when the world say they came to save us
They got some new data
Tell us we're all wrong
We need uhm
Yeah, we need them
What about our own selves
Why don't we love ourselves
How did we forget

I've been movin out
They say they love me but I know it's not
What is this that you're tryna do to me?
Do all these lies in the way you speak?
The only thing we got left now are memories
So just let us go and end this misery
Let us leave so we can finally breathe
Get away from here
We want nothin more than to be free
Just like my momma said
Love will set uhm all free
But for real
Who am i kidding
Even if
She could see
If she could hear

Started from nothing
They said I'll never amount to nothin'
I just had the will to follow my own path
And fight for what I know is right
Look at me now
How far we've come
It's like a dream
I keep remembering all of the dreams
That you gave me
You believed in me
Even when I couldn't believe myself
Thank you
For believing
Just keep it
To yourself
Please don't say thank you
